title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Who Could Not Roar
moral: Everyone has something special they can do.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a silver t-shirt with a red robot print, dark blue jeans, and bright yellow sneakers — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} walked into a big green jungle.
Tall trees touched the blue sky.
Colourful parrots flew overhead.
A small silver robot stood by a tree.
The robot looked very sad.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} went over to the little robot.
"What is wrong?" asked {{NAME}}.
"I want to roar like a dinosaur," said the robot.
"But all I can do is beep."
{{NAME}}'s eyes went wide with an idea.

pages.content:
Just then, a big blue dinosaur ran up.
He roared and roared very loudly.
All the animals ran away fast.
The robot beeped, beeped, beeped.
The animals stopped and came back to listen.

pages.content:
The animals loved the robot's beeping music.
They danced in the soft jungle light.
Even the big dinosaur started to sway.
"Your beeping is wonderful," said {{NAME}}.
The robot's eyes glowed bright and happy.

pages.content:
The robot danced with all the animals.
The dinosaur sat down with a happy sigh.
The parrots sang along to the beeping.
{{NAME}} leaned against the big soft dinosaur.
He felt warm and happy and very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow the robot has a new song just for you.
